# The lines that diego-sshd writes to vm-launch's guest agent relay, and the
# answers that diego-sshd relies on. garden-runc-release keeps this file at
# src/code.cloudfoundry.org/guardian/cmd/vm-launch/testdata/guest-agent-relay-contract.txt
# and diego-release keeps the same file at
# src/code.cloudfoundry.org/diego-ssh/handlers/testdata/guest-agent-relay-contract.txt.
# vm-launch's specs check the real relay against it, and diego-ssh's specs
# check their fake relay against it, so the two copies change together.
#
# Each case is one line of four fields separated by " | ".
#
# The state is the relay's guest. "agent" has an agent that answers, "off"
# has no agent, and "down" has an agent that cannot be reached.
#
# The line is what the client writes, without its newline. PORT stands for a
# TCP port that echoes what it reads.
#
# The answer is "ok" exactly, "error:", which stands for "error: " and a
# reason that is not empty, or "off:", which stands for "off: " and a reason
# that is not empty. The relay answers a ping with "off:" only when its guest
# has no agent by configuration, and diego-sshd then serves as it does in a
# container without the agent. Any other answer but ok means the agent is
# down.
#
# After is "eof" when the relay closes the connection after its answer, and
# "stream" when the connection then carries the raw bytes of the forward.
agent | ping | ok | eof
agent | forward 127.0.0.1 PORT | ok | stream
agent | forward 127.0.0.1 notaport | error: | eof
agent | forward 127.0.0.1 | error: | eof
agent | shell | error: | eof
off | ping | off: | eof
off | forward 127.0.0.1 PORT | error: | eof
down | ping | error: | eof
